title: Handheld Weather Station — Gust & Gloom
excerpt: Handheld Weather Station — Gust & Gloom — A pocket weather station that is polite about humidity and extremely suspicious of umbrellas. What's included: Sensor board, 3D-printed enclosure, USB charging cable, Quick start guide.
